'''Vitor Alves Da Silva Portuguese Temperament''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Vitor Alves Da Silva]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds50.htm Portuguese Temperament], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020727174311/http://trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds50.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Vitor Alves Da Silva]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
